basic_info: Virginia, female, age unspecified, visit time unspecified, chief complaint: knee pain and swelling following a basketball injury
present_illness: Onset of knee pain and swelling following a basketball injury when colliding with Jerry, resulting in a fall. Pain is localized to the inner knee, and swelling has persisted. Patient applied ice and an ace wrap but cannot bear weight on the affected knee. The pain is on the inside of the knee, right where it's swollen. It doesn't radiate anywhere else. There is no locking or clicking, but it does feel unstable sometimes, like it might give way if the patient tries to put too much weight on it. The patient was playing basketball, and Jerry ran into her. She thinks she twisted her knee a little before falling to the ground on her side. She didn't land directly on her knee, but it still hurt a lot, and she couldn't get back up right away.
past_history: No prior knee injuries or surgeries.
physical_exam: Physical examination findings are pending. The patient reports localized pain on the inner knee, swelling, and a sensation of instability without locking or clicking. The patient is unable to bear weight on the affected knee.
aux_exam: X-ray was performed, showing swelling and fluid in the knee without fractures. MRI not performed yet.
